newsitem.title: USA: BIG Entertainment March same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: BIG Entertainment March same-store sales up.

text.p: BIG Entertainment Inc said preliminary results from the company's entertainment retail division show same-store sales increased by 22.5 percent for March 1997 from March 1996.
Preliminary results also indicate that same-store sales for the first quarter of 1997 increased 18.6 percent from the corresponding period of 1996.
BIG said preliminary results also show that retail sales for all stores for March 1997 increased 118 percent from retail sales in March 1996.
